description: This file defines the interface for an OmiProxy in the omi namespace, providing methods for mounting and unmounting crypted containers, and registering/unregistering error listeners.

classes.name: IOmiProxy
classes.description: Interface for Omi Proxy, offering container management and event listener registration functionalities.

methods.name: mountCryptedBundle
methods.description: Mounts a crypted container bundle, given its identifiers and file paths, and outputs the decrypted config JSON payload path.

methods.name: umountCryptedBundle
methods.description: Unmounts a crypted container bundle identified by its ID.

methods.name: registerListener
methods.description: Registers an error listener callback and returns a listener ID.

methods.name: unregisterListener
methods.description: Unregisters an error listener with the given tag ID.
